statement.p: Find the velocity \vec{v}(t) and the speed \|\vec{v}(t)\| of a particle with position x = 2t^{2}-4t+2,\quad y = 8t^{3}-12t^{2},\quad z = 8.
Find any times at which the particle stops.

p.em: (Give your answer as a time or list of times, comma separated.)

static.solution: \vec{v} is given by: \vec{v} = \frac{d}{dt}(2t^{2}-4t+2)\vec i+\frac{d}{dt}(8t^{3}-12t^{2})\vec j+ \frac{d}{dt}(8)\vec k = (4\mathopen{}\left(t-1\right))\,\vec i + (24t\mathopen{}\left(t-1\right))\,\vec j + (0)\,\vec k. The speed is given by: \|\vec v\|=\sqrt{(4\mathopen{}\left(t-1\right))^{2} + (24t\mathopen{}\left(t-1\right))^{2} + (0)^2} = 4|t - 1|\sqrt{ 1 + 36 t^2}. The particle stops when \vec v = \vec 0, so when t = 1. Since this is the only time when all components of the velocity are zero, it is the only time that the particle stops.
